sheets.name: Summary
rows: Global smartphone shipments and vendor share for calendar year 2025 (latest full year as of November 2026). Figures were published January 2026; IDC data is preliminary.
Apple was the world's largest smartphone vendor in 2025 in every tracker read: 247.8M units and 19.7% share per IDC [1], about 20% per Counterpoint [3], 240.6M units per Omdia [6].
Samsung was a close second: 241.2M units and 19.1% per IDC [1]; the Apple lead is only about 6.6M units [1].
Xiaomi held third place at about 13% (165.3M units per IDC [1]), with shipments down 1.9% [1].
The market totaled about 1.25 to 1.26 billion units, up roughly 2% year on year [1][3][6][8].
